summary: Iteration 48 — Targeted regression of the 2 frontend fixes flagged in iteration_47.json. Both bugs from iteration 47 are resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: parseFlatPhones now correctly tokenises by /[\r\n,;]+/ before applying the phone regex /(\+?\d[\d \-]{6,}\d)/ — newline-separated paste is now reliable.
SalesManagerDashboard.js:289 now passes smId={user?.id} so LeadDistributionPanel.jsx's `{!smId && ...}` block correctly hides the admin SM picker on the SM view.

Note: the SM account used in this run (salesmanager@celestaglow.com — 'Hubby Brahman') has 0 TCs and only 1 ASM (Ravi Kumar). UI shows 'No telecallers under this Sales Manager' but allocation still proceeds — minor cosmetic inconsistency, not a blocker. This is pre-existing seed behaviour (already flagged in iter47 context).
